meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: Claude 会按 9 个维度(架构、一致性、类型、测试、依赖、性能、错误处理、安全、文档)扫描代码库,产出仓库根目录的 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,内含严重度分级、工时估算和优先级修复清单,每条发现都标注 file:line:col 引用。
howto.when: 当你要求做代码库健康检查、技术债审计、清理规划等,或提到 “tech debt”、“code health” 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 对这个仓库做一次技术债审计,结果写到 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say.note: 会按 9 个维度扫描并输出审计文件

say.text: 帮我检查代码健康:找出超大文件、死代码和循环依赖
say.note: 发现按严重度和工时排序

say.text: 只审安全和错误处理这两个维度,每条给出文件行号

howto.what_en: Claude scans the repo across 9 dimensions and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md in the repo root, with severity, effort estimates and a prioritized fix list. Every finding cites file:line:col.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a codebase health check, tech debt audit, cleanup planning, etc., or mention "tech debt", "code health" and similar keywords.

say_en.text: Run a tech debt audit on this repo and write results to TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say_en.note: Scans all 9 dimensions and writes the report

say_en.text: Check code health: find god files, dead code and import cycles
say_en.note: Findings are ranked by severity and effort

say_en.text: Audit only security and error handling, with file:line:col per finding
say_en.note: You can limit which dimensions run
